title: Constructible and primary reduction on curves
statement:
For a separated finite-type curve $X$ over an algebraically closed field and
a torsion sheaf $F$, extension-invariance of $H^q(X,F)$ reduces to the case
where $X$ is reduced and $F$ is a constructible $\mathbf F_\ell$-sheaf.

proof.text: Take the nilradical reduction i : C_red → C. Install reducedness and its surjective closed immersion from the existing reduction lemma. Its underlying homeomorphism transports the dimension bound; separatedness, finite type and quasi-compactness compose, so i ≫ f is again a curve.
For each constructible Λ-module sheaf on this fixed reduced curve, apply constructible-prime devissage. Supply its prime-field hypothesis by specializing H to i ≫ f.

Pull F back to the reduction; the library torsion pullback instance preserves its torsion. Apply constructible approximation with the result of the preceding step to obtain all eight assertions for this pullback.
Apply the reduction comparison to this actual pulled-back sheaf and its assertions, obtaining the original eight assertions unchanged.
